test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 01 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is: **watching**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"watching"** refers to the act of observing someone or something carefully or in order to gain information. (देखना)

 
 
• **Example: **She spent the afternoon watching the birds in her garden.
 
 
 
• Hence, the activity of carefully observing someone or something for information or pleasure is best described by the word **'watching'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Risking** (जोखिम उठाना): Exposing someone or something valued to danger, harm, or loss.

 
 
• **Example:** He was risking his life to save the child from the burning building.
 
 
 
• **Practising** (अभ्यास करना): Performing an activity or exercise regularly in order to improve or maintain one's proficiency.
 
 
• **Example: **She is practising her speech for the competition tomorrow.
 
 
 
• "Wallowing" refers to indulging in an unrestrained way in something that creates a pleasurable sensation. (लोटना)
 
 
• Example: After the breakup, he was wallowing in self-pity.
